headline: Strong Topline; Margin Recovery Intact Despite PAT Miss

highlights: Key Points  Revenue Beat; PAT Miss: Suprajit Engineering reported 2QFY27 consolidated revenue of Rs11.35bn (+20.6% YoY, +6.1% QoQ), beating NBIE/BBG estimates by 3.8%/2.9%.
Growth was led by GCM (+24.3% YoY) and SED (+50.4% YoY), with ICM (+13.7% YoY) and PLE (+14.8% YoY) also posting double-digit growth.

EBITDA rose 39.0% YoY to Rs1.38bn (3.1% below NBIE, 1.1% above BBG), with margin expanding by 161bps YoY to 12.2% (88bps/22bps below NBIE/BBG), as sequential recovery in ICM and PLE offset pressure in SED.
GCM is guided to sustain double-digit growth with 10-12% margins, although 2H growth may moderate from 1H levels (~24%) as some customers built inventory buffers against freight delays.
valuation: SED margins should return to double digits once customer repricing is secured.  Valuation: We maintain our BUY rating with a revised target price of Rs634 (from Rs652), valuing the stock at 22x Sep-28E EPS.

CMP: Rs464 | Target Price (TP): Rs634 | Upside: 37% November 13, 2026 Institutional Equities Suprajit Engineering (SEL)2 Margin guidance retained; 2H to be better than 1H: Management retained FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin guidance of 12-13.5% (1HFY27: 12.1%) and expects 2H margins to modestly exceed 1H.
